summary: DevRelay 0.10.0-rc.2 is an accepted deterministic Windows source/library preview. RM-001 adds a human-controlled roadmap module and mandatory fresh-task context proof without changing Core authority or the construction lifecycle.
stakeholders: Module, adapter, pack, and host authors
domainConstraints: The released lifecycle and Gate ownership remain authoritative.
Roadmap detection creates candidates only and cannot mutate approved scope.
Every fresh DevRelay task binds exact current context and a fail-closed receipt.
Explicit ModuleInvocation ports remain the only execution inputs.
conventions: Use content-addressed artifacts and immutable versioned policy.
Ask clarification questions in breadth-first waves.
Keep human projections concise and derive them from structured baselines.
Preserve discarded, deferred, and merged candidates for audit.
Use optional adapters only behind provider-neutral module contracts.
